data.name: Badeeun
data.gender_notes: Badeeun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic word 'badi' meaning new, and 'un' meaning fresh or blooming. It reflects the essence of new beginnings, renewal, and growth. The name Badeeun carries the meaning “New, fresh, blooming” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Badeeun usually hope their child will grow to embody new, fresh, blooming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Badeeun is a name that evokes the sense of newness and renewal in the spiritual realm. It is a reminder of the constant opportunity for growth and transformation, and the potential for a fresh start in one's spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Badeeun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “New, fresh, blooming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Badeeun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: بَادِعُون
in_arabic.meaning: معرب لفظ من اصل عربي، ينطوي على معنى الرائع والجميل
in_arabic.long_meaning: بَادِعُون اسم عربي أصيل، مشتق من الفعل "بِدَعَ" الذي يعني "أحدث" أو "أنشأ" . يتصور بَادِعُون بأنه من أضاف شيئًا جميلًا أو رائعًا، إما في الكلمة أو الفعل أو العمل. لا توجد إشارات مباشرة إلى اسم بَادِعُون في القرآن الكريم، لكنه يحمل دلالات إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية، كرمز للابتكار، والإبداع، والجمال.

in_urdu.name: بَادِعُون
in_urdu.meaning: معرب لفظ، زیبا و دلکش کا معنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: بَادِعُون ایک عربی نام ہے، جو الفعل "بِدَعَ" سے نکلا ہے جس کا معنی "نئی چیز بنانا" یا "نئی ایجاد کرنا" ہے۔ بَادِعُون کسی ایسے شخص کا نام ہے جس نے کوئی نئی اور خوبصورت چیز، کلام، عمل یا کوشش کی ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن پاک میں واضح طور پر موجود نہیں ہے لیکن اس کا اسلامی ثقافت میں مثبت معنی ہے، یہ نَشاط، خلاقیت اور خوبصورتی کا عکاس ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बादीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: बादीन एक अरबी नाम है, जो 'बِدَعَ' कर्म से बना है जिसका अर्थ 'नया बनाना' या 'नया उत्पन्न करना' होता है। बादीन उस व्यक्ति का नाम होता है जिसने कोई नई और सुन्दर चीज, शब्द, कार्य या प्रयास किया है। यह नाम कुरान में स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं है लेकिन इस्लामी संस्कृति में इसका सकारात्मक अर्थ है, यह क्रियाशीलता, रचनात्मकता और सौंदर्य का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: بَادِعُون
in_pashto.meaning: اسم عربي، چې معنی وي خېل کېږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: بَادِعُون يو عربي نوم دی، چې د «بِدَعَ» діوالي له جوړ شوی دی. د «بِدَعَ» د لفظ معنی ”نو کړل” ته برابر دی. بَادِعُون د يو خوبو او خوب صورت هېواد ته ورته، په لفظ، فعال او کار کې د څو نوره جوړول وي. په قرآن کې د نوم باندې نومرې اشارې موجود نه دي، خو دا نوم د اسلامي مېرمنه کې مثبت معنی لري، د نوې سرچينې، خيال او زړه په خوله کې.

in_english.name: Badeeun
in_english.meaning: A beautiful and unique Arabic name
in_english.long_meaning: Badeeun is an Arabic name derived from the root "bada", meaning 'to create', 'to innovate', or 'to originate'. It signifies someone who brings something new and beautiful into existence, be it in words, actions, or endeavors. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, Badeeun carries positive connotations in Islamic tradition, symbolizing creativity, innovation, and elegance. It is a name often bestowed upon those who are seen as pioneers, visionaries, or those who possess a special talent for bringing beauty into the world.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Badeeun" carries a deep cultural significance, particularly during the Islamic practice of Hajj (pilgrimage to Mecca). The day of Arafat, a significant part of the Hajj pilgrimage, is known as the day of "badiyat Allah", or the "new badi" of Allah. On this day, Muslims gather and renew their faith, seeking forgiveness and asking Allah to accept their good deeds. This name reminds us of the importance of new beginnings and renewal, not just in the context of Hajj but as an ongoing process in life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Badeeun" is also rich in spiritual significance. In Islamic beliefs, it symbolizes new life, growth, and the blessings of Allah. It serves as a reminder of the ongoing transformation that occurs within each individual as they strive to lead a righteous life and seek closeness to Allah. More broadly, it reflects the continuous cycle of creation, renewal, and spiritual evolution in the universe, as outlined in the Quran (30:54). Ultimately, "Badeeun" is a call to embrace new opportunities for growth, and to cultivate a deep sense of faith and reverence for Allah along the way.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Badeeun (বাদেউন) in Arabic translates to "The Forgivers". This name symbolizes the infinite mercy and forgiveness of Allah SWT towards His creation, encouraging us to strive for forgiveness and seek Allah's mercy in our daily lives.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Badeeun was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and took part in several battles. The name Badeeun carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Badeeun was a prominent figure in early Islamic history.
